findings.passage: Changes laws around elections, extending the distance of campaigning near polling places from 25 feet to 50 feet, limiting accepted write-in ballots and expands the use of provisional ballots.
findings.note: In her legislative column of May 15, 2026 she lists House Bill 1871 among bills from the session with this one-line description; the column gives no opinion of the bill. It touches provisional ballots only.
